whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Capetown Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.5★ reviews from over 2,200 patrons in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page for table reservations.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/capetown

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Capetown Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your vibrant atmosphere in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
